lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Today is a beautiful day.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I had a dream of a time when humanity reclaimed the surface.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Grave woke me with a voice as sweet as honey.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: When I opened my eyes, the sky was clear,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: and all I could hear was the gentle whispers of the wind.
Sounds like a fairy tale.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Yes, that's right.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: And now that I'm speaking with you, Prince,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: it has truly become a perfectly beautiful day.
Stop, you're making me blush.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Ever since I decided to

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: regain control of my story,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: you are an irreplaceable character in it.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: In these beautiful, fairytale moments,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: you must always be by my side.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: how has your day been so far?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Have I helped it become more beautiful?
Of course.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Just as I thought.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm a vital character in your story as well.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Of course, I have always heard how there are

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: many characters in your story.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I simply must ask:

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Where do I stand among them?
Hmm, that's a tough one...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: I'm not sure if you're avoiding the question,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: or if you truly believe that rankings don't matter because I'm number one.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: At any rate, today is a beautiful day,

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: so I won't press the matter.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: The most important thing is how our story ends.
Thank you...

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Let's make sure our stories have a happy ending.
Yes, let's.
